ownerFactRefs.scope: E2 Proposal internal version design: supersede the 140/141 Proposal generation version-family architecture while preserving the approved 136 Explore feasibility facts and E2 required outcomes.
requiredOutcomes: Do not establish independent long-lived version lifecycles for Context, ActionPackage, verification selection/evidence schema, renderer, or Verification Catalog.

E2 itself continues on the pre-E2/current runner and may implement generic Verification; post-E2 prospective three-file writer activates only after the E2 checkpoint, with F1 as first formal dogfood consumer.
Flowkit product version remains the product-level version; current Git/source defines current internal implementation.
Historical E1 persisted shapes remain immutable and readable through small bounded legacy compatibility; do not migrate historical E1 Runs or build a generic migration/version framework.

Historical verification publication should validate persisted bytes/fingerprint/binding rather than require renderer-version replay; keep only the minimum bounded compatibility mechanism actually required.

Preserve generic Change Verification, current-Change decoupling, prospective three-file Run, historical E1 readability, crash/recovery correctness, next-consumer regressions, and E1→E2→F1→G1 dependency boundary without expanding into F1/G1/03 scope.
Use a minimal formatVersion only when a persisted breaking format cannot be reliably discriminated structurally by the latest reader; formatVersion is only a serialization discriminator.
Verification Catalog has no generation lifecycle; current source is authority and point-in-time identity uses content fingerprint when needed.

findings.title: Delivery Manifest 仍把 versioned renderer 作为 E2 正式 output
findings.problem: Owner Contract Reset 明确废弃 renderer 独立版本生命周期，142 Proposal/Design 也改为 current implementation + persisted content identity + bounded legacy recognition；但 Delivery Manifest 的 E2 outputs 仍保留 `versioned generic verification renderer / historical selection independence`。该 output 是 Delivery 的 durable formal plan，继续要求一个已被 Owner supersede 的 versioned renderer 产物。
findings.invariant: Owner Contract Reset 后，current Delivery Manifest、Proposal、Design、Specs 必须表达同一 current contract；不得让已被 supersede 的 renderer version lifecycle 继续作为 E2 formal output。
findings.requiredOutcome: 把 E2 formal output 更新为与 Owner Reset 一致的非版本化 verification publication / historical selection independence 表达；不得继续要求 versioned renderer lifecycle。
acceptance: E2 Manifest outputs 不再包含 `versioned generic verification renderer` 或等价 renderer version-family 要求。
Manifest、Proposal、Design、Specs 对 historical verification authority 的表达一致：persisted identity + bounded legacy read，current renderer 不成为历史 currentness authority。

findings.title: OpenSpec delta 未重命名仍编码旧 sidecar/ActionPackage 版本模型的 canonical Requirement 身份
findings.problem: 142 删除了 140 中全部 RENAMED Requirements。OpenSpec strict 虽通过，但 disposable OpenSpec 1.7 archive-sync 实际结果为 modified=8、renamed=0；archive 后 canonical specs 仍保留 `Core 必须发布 immutable verification-selection record` 与 `ActionPackage v2 必须携带 typed declaration identity` 这些旧 Requirement 名称。前者把 post-E2 不再存在的 per-Run verification-selection record 固化为 canonical Requirement identity，后者继续把 ActionPackage v2 固化为 current canonical Requirement identity，均与 Owner Reset 的 current implementation + bounded legacy compatibility 方向不一致。
findings.invariant: E2 archive 后的 canonical OpenSpec contract 必须描述 post-E2 current product model；历史 E1/v1/v2/v5 名称可以作为 scenario 中的 bounded legacy facts，但不得继续作为 current Requirement identity 固化已被 supersede 的 sidecar或 component-version architecture。
findings.requiredOutcome: 在 current E2 delta 中对仍编码 superseded sidecar/component-version architecture 的 canonical Requirement identity 做必要的 RENAMED，名称应描述非版本化 current semantics；historical v1/v2/v5/renderer 字段只留在 bounded legacy scenarios。不要恢复 140 中 `ActionPackage 必须版本化...` 这种同样被 Owner Reset 废弃的名称。
acceptance: OpenSpec delta 对至少 `immutable verification-selection record` 与 `ActionPackage v2 ...` 的 current Requirement identity 完成非版本化 rename（具体新名称由 Author 在 current contract 下选择）。
Disposable OpenSpec 1.7 archive-sync 显示对应 RENAMED operations，并且 MODIFIED/RENAMED 后 canonical Requirement 数量与 scenarios 完整保留。
archive 后 canonical Requirement 名称不再把 post-E2 current model表述为 per-Run verification-selection sidecar或 ActionPackage component version。
不得采用 140 已 supersede 的 `ActionPackage 必须版本化...` 等 version-family 名称。
